div.div:
Swedish UI message constants (questions, success and error texts) are left out to keep the diagram readable.
Dependencies on BankService, UserManagement and ConsoleInputValidation in the menu classes come from primary constructors and are drawn as «use». All menu options throw UserInputException, which MainMenu catches.
